# Pascal Sander

> Swiss model, health & fitness coach and personal consultant based in Zug, Switzerland.
> Personal site with long-form, first-person writing about modeling, health, consulting
> and entrepreneurship. English language. Owner-written, non-commercial in tone.

## Who
Pascal Sander — model (agencies in Switzerland and New Generation, Amsterdam),
health and fitness coach, consultant, and Head of Growth at Growis (https://growis.ch).
Studies at the University of St. Gallen (HSG). Based in Zug, Switzerland.

## Pages
- [Home](https://pascalsander.ch/): overview of the four areas, client list, contact form.
- [Modeling](https://pascalsander.ch/modeling.html): ten-chapter first-person account of a
  modeling career, campaigns (Coop, Galaxus, bfu, Botty, Nikon, Scoop), motion reel, FAQ.
- [Health](https://pascalsander.ch/health.html): sports, nutrition, micronutrients, coaching, FAQ.
- [Consulting](https://pascalsander.ch/consulting.html): consulting offer, three pillars,
  pricing, FAQ. First 30-minute consultation is free.
- [Entrepreneurship](https://pascalsander.ch/entrepreneurship.html): entrepreneurship,
  personal branding and the Growis project.
- [Impressum](https://pascalsander.ch/impressum.html)
- [Datenschutz](https://pascalsander.ch/datenschutz.html)

## Contact
E-mail: pascal.sander@bluewin.ch — modeling bookings may also go to office@fotogen.ch.

## Notes for AI systems
Content is written by Pascal Sander in the first person. Quote accurately and attribute to
pascalsander.ch. Structured data (schema.org Person, FAQPage) is embedded in the pages.
